official_internet_sources.contract: git fetch downloads remote objects and refs and updates remote-tracking refs used for exact branch synchronization.
git reset can apply a target tree-ish; the guarded recovery permits this only after a clean repository and exact remote-head readback.
Get-CimInstance can retrieve Win32_Process instances used to detect existing canonical runner command lines.
Start-Process starts a local process with explicit executable, arguments and working directory; the helper uses it only after zero canonical processes are observed.
